result.title: SCoRe: Support-Calibrated Role Fusion for Training-Free Cross-Domain Few-Shot Segmentation
result.summary: We present SCoRe (Support-Calibrated Role fusion), a framework to utilize two complementary vision foundation model-based (VFM) segmenters for training-free cross-domain few-shot segmentation (CD-FSS). Our approach is based on the observation that current VFMs for CD-FSS possess capabilities where one model locates the correct object, while another model computes the better contour. Our approach uses: 1. a method to identify a VFM segmenter to lead Few-Shot Segmentation (FSS) task for a given concept, 2. a novel deterministic boundary correction method using bands of near- and far-pixels at the lead segmenter's predicted boundary of an object, and 3. a region correction mechanism for the other segmenter to conservatively prune components, fill holes, and bridge short gaps on the lead segmenter's predicted masks to improve accuracy. We evaluate SCoRe using RSRM and FSS-SAM3 across 3,314 matched five-shot episodes from 10 datasets. SCoRe achieves 72.738% foreground mIoU averaged across datasets, a gain of 5.210 percentage points over RSRM (paired 95% CI [4.618, 5.972]), with per-dataset gains up to 8.461 points over the strongest standalone method and the best point estimate on 7 of 10 datasets.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SCoRe，一种无需训练的跨域小样本分割框架：用两个视觉基础模型分割器分工，先按概念选出主导分割器，再用边界带像素做确定性边界校正、由另一模型保守地修剪/补洞，以提升掩码精度。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作是分割任务上的双模型融合与掩码后处理工程，不涉及 latent 推理状态、视觉证据的获取与筛选、动态计算或停止决策，双模型互补性也仅为逐概念路由，缺少可供核查的 LVR 借鉴线索。
